title: Registration & Morning Coffee
abstract: Check-in at the registration desk, collect your badge and DevFest swag bag, and connect with fellow developers over fresh morning coffee.

title: Opening Keynote: Shipping Agents to Production
speaker: amara
abstract: A comprehensive deep dive into production-grade multi-agent architectures, reliable tool calling, deployment patterns, and operational guardrails on Google Cloud.

title: Jetpack Compose in the Real World
speaker: daniel
abstract: Architectural lessons, state management patterns, and performance optimizations learned from running Jetpack Compose at scale in mission-critical fintech applications.

title: Interactive Workshop: BigQuery Tricks Nobody Told You
speaker: sofia
abstract: Hands-on masterclass covering partition pruning, clustering heuristics, BI engine acceleration, and cost reduction strategies for petabyte queries.

title: Fast Sites with Less JavaScript
speaker: kenji
abstract: How to deliver lightning-fast web experiences and achieve perfect Core Web Vitals by leveraging modern CSS, native HTML capabilities, and minimal client script.

title: Networking Lunch & Community Expo
abstract: Enjoy lunch while exploring partner booths, community showcases, interactive product demos, and networking with tech leaders.

title: Zero Trust in the Age of Autonomous AI
speaker: zainab
abstract: Deconstructing threats in autonomous agent ecosystems, programmatic credentials, sandboxing boundaries, and practical Zero Trust implementations in the enterprise.

title: Community Lightning Talks & Open Mic
abstract: Fast-paced 5-minute community presentations on local open-source projects, developer tools, and community initiatives.

title: Day 2 Breakfast & Welcome
abstract: Kick off Day 2 with light refreshments, recap of Day 1 highlights, and schedule overview for the upcoming sessions.

title: Evaluating AI Agents Before They Reach Users
speaker: chidi
abstract: Quantitative benchmarks, evaluation harness design, synthetic stress tests, and automated validation frameworks for complex autonomous LLM systems.

title: Masterclass: Multi-Platform Design Systems with Flutter
speaker: kwame
abstract: Step-by-step guidance on constructing scalable design systems that render consistently and beautifully across mobile, web, and desktop using Flutter.

title: GitOps and Next-Gen CI/CD at Scale
speaker: aisha
abstract: Declarative infrastructure management, automated rollbacks, policy as code, and progressive delivery pipelines built on modern GitOps principles.

title: Lunch & Women Techmakers Meetup
abstract: Networking lunch with dedicated tables hosting the Women Techmakers community discussion on mentorship, diversity, and leadership in technology.

title: Frontiers of Contextual Reasoning and Tool Use
speaker: marcus
abstract: Exploring recent breakthroughs in long-horizon reasoning, structured agentic tool execution, and alignment challenges in next-generation foundation models.

title: Panel: The Future of Developer Ecosystems
speaker: kenji
abstract: An interactive panel discussion on modern developer workflows, tool fragmentation, the rise of AI coding agents, and the open web ecosystem.

title: Closing Ceremony & Hackathon Awards
abstract: Celebration of DevFest 2026, presentation of hackathon winner awards, community shout-outs, and official group photo.
